findings_qualitative.value: CO-detected early-type galaxies have atmospheric cooling time below ~1 Gyr at 10 kpc; no relation with t_c/t_ff

evidence.quote: We find no relationship between the ratio of the cooling time to free fall time, $t_{\rm c}/t_{\rm ff}$, and the presence or absence of molecular clouds in early-type galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Molecular gas in ETGs condensed from hot atmospheres, like in BCGs
claims.experiment: Chandra thermodynamic profiles of 40 ETGs compared with CO masses, combined with BCG sample
claims.result: M_mol ∝ M_X^1.4±0.1, ∝ n_e^1.8±0.3; detections when t_c < ~1 Gyr at 10 kpc
claims.finding: Data consistent with much molecular gas condensing from hot atmospheres

evidence.quote: The data are consistent with much of the molecular gas in early-type galaxies having condensed from their hot atmospheres.

claims.hypothesis: Thermal instability threshold t_c/t_ff predicts molecular gas
claims.experiment: Plot t_c/t_ff profiles split by CO detection
claims.finding: t_c/t_ff plays no role; t_c is the better indicator

evidence.quote: The systems with CO detections do not segregate from those with CO upper limits.
